latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of xiaopi-skill-finder-cn (skill-finder-cn)
- Enables users to discover and install ClawHub Skills by searching and recommending based on user requests
- Supports queries like "找一个能做X的skill" or "有什么skill可以…"
- Provides example commands for searching, inspecting, and installing skills via ClawHub
- Guides users through a workflow: understanding needs, keyword extraction, searching, listing skills, and installation suggestions
